historicalBaseline.note: These identifiers describe only the Founder-delivered historical baseline. They do not describe the reconciled integration candidate archive or unpacked tree.

integrationCandidate.note: This is the immutable BEAAA-20298 input commit. The BEAAA-20300 reconciliation commit is a later provenance-only descendant and is recorded in the issue evidence because a file cannot truthfully contain the hash of the commit that contains that file.

artifact.manifestAlgorithm: For each regular file, from unpacked tree root: LC_ALL=C sorted relative path; sha256sum line format `<file_sha256>  ./<relative_path>\n`; manifest SHA-256 is SHA-256 of the manifest bytes.
